retail.checkout_process: Customer adds items to cart and proceeds to checkout. System validates items are in stock. Payment is processed immediately. If payment succeeds, order confirmation is sent. If payment fails, customer is notified and can retry.
retail.return_management: Customer initiates return request with order number and reason. System validates return eligibility (within 30 days, item condition). If eligible, customer receives return shipping label. Customer ships item back. When warehouse receives package, staff verify item condition. If condition is acceptable, refund is processed. If condition is damaged, customer is notified and return is denied. Customer receives refund confirmation email.
retail.bulk_order_with_partial_fulfillment: Manager submits bulk order for 500 units across 5 different products. System checks inventory availability for each product. If all products have sufficient stock, order is reserved and scheduled for immediate packing. If any product has insufficient stock, system notifies manager of shortage and asks: proceed with partial shipment now or wait for full stock. If manager chooses partial shipment, system splits order into two shipments (available items ship now, backorder items ship when stock arrives). If manager chooses to wait, entire order is held in pending status. When backorder items arrive in warehouse, system ships remaining items if partial shipment already sent, or ships complete order if nothing shipped yet.

finance.simple_invoice_payment: Finance team receives invoice from vendor. Invoice is logged into accounting system. Payment due date is calculated. On due date, system generates payment request. Finance manager approves payment. Payment is processed via bank transfer. Vendor receives payment confirmation.
finance.moderate_loan_application: Customer submits loan application with personal and financial information. System performs initial validation (age, credit history, income verification). If validation fails, applicant is notified immediately. If passes, application goes to loan officer for detailed review. Loan officer may request additional documentation. Once all documents received, loan officer runs risk assessment. If approved, loan terms are generated and sent to customer for acceptance. If rejected, customer is notified with reason. If customer accepts terms, loan is funded and disbursed to customer account.
finance.complex_multi_currency_payment_reconcili: Bank receives daily payments in multiple currencies (USD, EUR, GBP) from international customers. System converts all amounts to base currency using daily exchange rates. System matches each payment to an outstanding invoice in the accounting system. If payment matches invoice amount exactly, payment is recorded as complete. If payment is less than invoice amount, system marks invoice as partially paid and holds remaining balance. If payment is more than invoice amount, system records overpayment as credit for future invoices. If payment doesn't match any invoice, system holds payment as unmatched and notifies accounting team to investigate. Accounting team researches whether payment is for old invoice, contains reference number, or is duplicate payment. Once reconciliation complete, system updates accounts receivable aging report and triggers automatic follow-up for overdue invoices.

healthcare.simple_appointment_scheduling: Patient calls clinic and requests appointment. Receptionist checks available time slots. If slots available, receptionist books appointment and sends confirmation. If no slots available, patient is placed on waitlist. When cancellation occurs, patient on waitlist is called and offered the slot.
healthcare.moderate_prescription_fulfillment: Doctor prescribes medication for patient. Prescription is sent electronically to pharmacy. Pharmacy technician receives prescription and checks patient insurance eligibility and prior authorization requirements. If prior authorization required, pharmacy contacts insurance company. If insurance approves, prescription is filled and patient is notified to pick up. If insurance denies, patient and doctor are notified of denial reason. Patient can appeal denial or doctor can prescribe alternative. Customer picks up filled prescription after signing receipt.
healthcare.complex_patient_hospital_admission: Patient arrives at emergency department with complaint. Triage nurse assesses severity and assigns acuity level (Level 1-5). Based on acuity and bed availability, patient is admitted to monitored bed or waits in ED area. Physician performs assessment and orders tests. Based on results, physician determines if patient needs hospital admission or discharge. If admission required, system checks available bed types (ICU, general ward) and assigns appropriate bed based on acuity level. If no bed available, system places patient in waiting queue and notifies nursing manager. Once bed assigned, admission team transfers patient and initiates protocols: medication reconciliation and allergy verification. Pharmacy reviews all medications for interactions. If interaction found, prescribing physician is notified and must adjust regimen. System tracks insurance authorization for admission. If not covered, billing team contacts patient for approval. Throughout stay, system monitors physician orders and alerts physician if critical lab values detected.

manufacturing.simple_production_order: Production manager creates work order for product. Bill of materials (BOM) is pulled. Raw materials are reserved from inventory. Production line is scheduled. Components are manufactured according to specifications. Quality check is performed. If passes, product is moved to finished goods. If fails, defective product is scrapped and waste is logged.
manufacturing.moderate_supplier_procurement: Manufacturing plant forecasts material needs for next 3 months. Purchase orders are generated for suppliers. Supplier receives PO and confirms availability and delivery date. Materials are shipped. When materials arrive at receiving dock, warehouse staff verify: quantity matches PO, quality matches specifications, and no damage during shipping. If discrepancy, items are rejected and returned to supplier. If accepted, materials are logged into inventory and routed to production. Invoice from supplier is matched to PO and receipt. If all three match (3-way match), invoice is approved for payment. If mismatch, finance team investigates.
manufacturing.complex_inventory_shortage_handling: Production line requires Component X but inventory shows insufficient stock. System checks: when is next supplier delivery? If delivery within 24 hours, production is delayed slightly and components arrive in time. If delivery more than 24 hours away, system checks: do we have alternative component that works? If yes, system notifies production to use alternative (may require minor adjustments). If no alternative available, system checks: can we expedite supplier shipment for premium cost? Production manager approves expedite. Supplier agrees to rush delivery. Meanwhile, system notifies dependent production lines of potential delay. If expedite fails or supplier cannot deliver, system escalates to procurement manager to find backup supplier. Backup supplier confirms they have stock and can deliver same day. Purchase order is created for backup supplier. Component arrives from backup supplier at premium cost. Production line resumes. Variance in cost is logged and supplier performance metrics are updated.

telecommunications.simple_service_activation: Customer signs up for mobile service. Customer selects plan and phone. System creates account and assigns phone number. SIM card is activated on network. Welcome SMS is sent. Customer can immediately use service.
telecommunications.moderate_bill_dispute_resolution: Customer disputes charges on bill. Customer contacts support and submits dispute ticket with description of issue. Support agent reviews account history, usage records, and service logs to verify charges. If agent confirms error, credit is issued immediately and customer is notified. If agent believes charges are correct, agent explains billing logic to customer. If customer still disputes, case is escalated to billing specialist. Specialist performs deep investigation, examining service logs, call records, and roaming agreements. If error confirmed, credit is issued retroactively. If charges confirmed correct, customer is offered service credits for future bills as goodwill. Case is closed.
telecommunications.complex_regional_network_outage: Network monitoring system detects high packet loss (5%+) in cell tower cluster. System analyzes: which specific towers affected, which services impacted (voice, 4G LTE), how many customers impacted. System automatically switches traffic to adjacent towers. Incident alert is sent to on-call engineers and NOC team. Field engineers are dispatched to affected towers. System analyzes root cause from logs: hardware failure, software issue, or capacity overload. If hardware failure suspected, spare parts are retrieved from inventory. If capacity overload suspected, traffic is temporarily prioritized to critical services. Field team arrives and connects diagnostic equipment. They confirm system's hypothesis and perform fix: replace failed hardware, rollback software, or activate backup circuit. During maintenance, system reroutes traffic and notifies affected customers. Once fix applied, system validates network metrics returned to normal. If not resolved, system escalates for further investigation. After full resolution, incident summary is logged for post-mortem analysis.

hospitality.simple_room_booking: Guest searches availability on website for dates and room type. System shows available rooms and pricing. Guest selects room and proceeds to booking. Payment is collected. Booking confirmation is sent to guest email and linked to loyalty account. Room is marked as reserved on housekeeping schedule.
hospitality.moderate_group_event_coordination: Corporate client requests conference room and catering for 50-person meeting. Event planner confirms dates and room availability. System calculates required setup: room capacity, furniture configuration, AV equipment needed. Catering team receives event details and prepares menu options. Client approves menu and final headcount. Catering prepares food day-before, stores appropriately, and prepares serving supplies. Day-of: housekeeping sets up room with configured furniture, IT team tests AV equipment, catering team delivers food in thermal containers and sets up buffet area. Event concludes, housekeeping breaks down setup and restores room to standard configuration.
hospitality.complex_multi_room_wedding_event: Couple books hotel for 100-person wedding with 50 guest rooms for 2 nights. Hotel enters contract covering: ceremony room rental, reception hall, guest rooms, catering, bar service. Over 3 months, couple confirms with coordinator: ceremony time, guest count, room assignments, menu selections, dietary restrictions, beverage selections, music/DJ arrangement. Coordinator creates master timeline and coordinates across departments. 2 weeks pre-event: final headcount confirmed, room block confirmed, dietary restrictions list finalized, AV equipment reserved. 1 week: facility walkthrough completed, seating chart finalized, name placards prepared, kitchen plans prep timeline, bar manager calculates alcohol quantities. Day-of-event: morning setup (ceremony room arranged, reception tables arranged, AV tested). Ceremony begins at scheduled time (guest check-in at 2pm, ceremony 3pm). Reception follows: guest check-in, catering service begins, bar opens, dancing begins, bar closes at midnight. Post-event: immediate cleanup (furniture removed, room reset), guest checkout next morning with luggage storage available. Final billing reconciles actual charges (room upgrades, extra bar charges, additional catering items) against estimated invoice.

education.simple_course_enrollment: Student logs into university portal and searches for courses available next semester. Student checks course details: time, location, professor, prerequisites, enrollment cap. If prerequisites met and seats available, student clicks enroll. System confirms enrollment and generates course schedule. Course roster is updated.
education.moderate_grade_appeals: Student receives final grade and believes it's incorrect. Student submits grade appeal form within 10 days of grade posting. Appeal goes to course professor. Professor reviews student's work, grading rubric, and appeal justification. Professor either: (a) confirms grade is correct and responds with explanation, or (b) adjusts grade if error found and notifies registrar. If student disagrees with professor's response, student escalates to department chair. Chair reviews appeal and professor's response and makes final determination. Outcome is communicated to student and registrar updates system.
education.complex_degree_requirement_validation: Student in senior year requests graduation check. System audits degree requirements: all courses completed, all credits earned (120 minimum), cumulative GPA meets minimum (2.0), major GPA meets minimum (varies by major). System checks: disciplinary holds cleared, library fees paid, student visa status current (if international). For each major course required, system verifies completion. For each general education requirement, system verifies completion. If student missing any requirement, system generates detailed report showing what's incomplete and deadline for completion. If all requirements met, graduation is approved. Diploma is prepared, cap-and-gown order placed, graduation ceremony slot assigned. At ceremony, attendance is verified and degree is conferred. Transcript is issued.

insurance.simple_auto_quote: Customer visits insurance website and enters vehicle information: make, model, year, VIN, driving history. System queries database for risk rating and loss history of similar vehicles. System calculates premium based: vehicle value, driver age, driving violations, coverage type. Quote is generated and displayed. Customer can purchase or save quote.
insurance.moderate_auto_claim_processing: Insured files claim after car accident. Claim agent is assigned and contacts claimant to collect details: accident date/time/location, other parties involved, police report number. Agent requests documentation: photos of damage, police report, medical records if injuries. Once documentation received, agent reviews for coverage validation: was accident during policy period? Does policy cover this type of damage? Claim is forwarded to appraiser. Appraiser inspects vehicle and estimates repair costs. Appraiser report is reviewed by claims adjuster. If repair cost is within policy limits, approval is issued. If cost exceeds limit, insured is notified. Once approved, insured selects repair shop. Insurer sends authorization to shop. Shop completes repairs and invoices insurer. Insurer verifies invoice matches approved estimate. If variation is reasonable, invoice is paid. Insured is notified when repairs complete.
insurance.complex_workers_compensation_claim: Worker suffers workplace injury and reports to employer. Employer submits injury report to insurer within 24 hours. Claims adjuster is assigned and contacts injured worker to collect injury details and confirm medical facility. Adjuster determines: Is injury work-related (covered)? What benefits apply: medical treatment coverage, disability income? Adjuster verifies: worker's current wage, employment history. Throughout recovery, adjuster authorizes medical treatment, reviews medical reports to confirm necessity, monitors if worker can return to work (full duty, light duty, partial duty). If dispute arises about injury severity, independent medical examination (IME) is ordered. IME physician provides second opinion. If worker can return to work, adjuster coordinates with employer for job placement. State workers compensation board receives regular status reports. At maximum medical improvement, adjuster calculates permanent disability award if applicable. Claim file is eventually closed.
